claim: Damped least-squares updates modify Gauss–Newton-style local corrections and stabilization.
claim_zh: 在Gauss–Newton型最小二乘迭代中加入阻尼。
innovation_detail: Introduce damping into Gauss–Newton-like least-squares steps.
innovation_detail_zh: 在Gauss–Newton型最小二乘迭代中加入阻尼。
bottleneck: Undamped local linearization can lead to unstable or overly aggressive parameter steps.
bottleneck_zh: 无阻尼局部线性化可能导致参数更新过大或不稳定。
tradeoff: Damping improves some convergence behavior but does not guarantee global optimality.
